html:
The Somali Republic was formed on 1 July 1960, when the newly independent British Somaliland joined the former Italian Somaliland to create one independent state with its capital at Mogadishu.

Its first president was Aden Abdullah Osman. The five-pointed star on its flag stood for the five lands where Somalis lived, including the Ogaden in Ethiopia, northeast Kenya and Djibouti, and claims to them led to clashes with its neighbours.

For nine years it was one of the few democracies in Africa, with lively clan-based parties. In 1969 President Abdirashid Ali Shermarke was killed, and Siad Barre seized power. The union of north and south later broke down in the civil war.
sum: The Somali Republic was formed on 1 July 1960, when the newly independent British Somaliland joined the former Italian Somaliland to create one independent state with its capital at Mogadishu.
